record.title: Molicel P45B harvested silicon-graphite | lithiation | 0.02C | Rehm2026

temperature.description: Half-cell numeric temperature not independently confirmed; the paper's 25 C full-cell ageing condition is not transferred.

x.definition: Branch progress normalized to [0,1], oriented by the named electrode lithiation/delithiation direction; not absolute stoichiometry or full-cell SOC. Original normalizedCapacity and row positions are retained in auxiliary CSV columns.
x.domain_basis: Retained native nodes only; no extrapolation, resampling or endpoint insertion.

cell_link.evidence: Harvested P45B electrodes in the same study as serial23 ageing checkups; exact donor-to-serial mapping unresolved.

processing.coordinate_transform: q01=(q-min(q))/(max(q)-min(q)); x=1-q01 if reverse_normalized_axis else q01; stable sort ascending x
processing.orientation_basis: Author filename electrode direction and endpoint potentials: potential decreases on lithiation, increases on delithiation. This is a curation coordinate, not a reconstruction of chronological acquisition order.
processing.nominal_rate_basis: Source filename and author folder notice
processing.selection: Entire author-processed branch, without smoothing, interpolation, clipping, row deletion or endpoint insertion. Source row is one-based in the original MAT vector.

limitations: Finite-current pseudo-OCP; polarization and branch hysteresis are retained, not a certified equilibrium OCP.
Same study/model does not establish identical half-cell/full-cell specimens.
Half-cell temperature not independently established; full-cell temperature settings are not transferred.
No independent electrochemical-model validation is claimed.
Author-processed normalized-capacity/potential table; time, measured current and absolute capacity are absent.
Protocol voltage cutoffs do not establish that each supplied table contains every protocol endpoint.

tum-rehm2026-v2.title: First-party Rehm2026 half-cell tables bundled with DegradationModeAnalysis v2.0.0
tum-rehm2026-v2.license_evidence: Fixed release metadata states MIT; bundled Mathias Rehm MIT notice and per-folder own-measurement attribution retained. Admission is limited to seven Rehm2026 first-party MATs, not third-party literature inputs.
tum-rehm2026-v2.role: Five harvested P45B branches and two laboratory graphite branches. Full-cell data remain externally linked.

rehm-2026.title: How to determine the degradation modes of lithium-ion batteries with silicon-graphite blend electrodes
rehm-2026.role: Methods Section 2.4 establishes lithium-counter coin-cell measurements; Data availability points to author GitHub. Article license is not used to relicense external tables.

experiment.protocol: Two cycles each at 0.05C, 0.033C and 0.02C; supplied filenames use 0.03C/0.02C. PE 3.0-4.3 V; SiGr 0.05-1.7 V vs Li.
experiment.selection: All seven allowlisted author-processed branches; exact cycle index not supplied.

export.note: Formula samples are calculated, not measurements. Read the record's coordinate, direction, conditions and license.
